entities.summary: Ahmadiyya Mikayil oghlu Jabrayilov was a purported French Resistance member of Azerbaijani ethnicity. The factual existence of Jabrailov is in dispute, with allegations that his official wartime biography was entirely fabricated Soviet propaganda.
